description: Reads the WhatsApp business profile customers see for one number, named by id, from Meta: about, description, address, email, websites, industry and the picture’s address. read_only_reason says when the profile is edited elsewhere (a coexistence number’s is edited in the WhatsApp Business app). Read-only.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: get_business_profile
title: Read a number’s business profile
